_comment: The T1 web arm's page-view counter, cookieless: the T1 sub-brand's own PostHog project, in the sub-brand's own organisation (ruling 7.10 §3, research/channel-loop/RULING-2026-10-07-posthog-organisation.md), never the brand's - the brand's project is in products/il-biz-tools/src/config/site.json, and the two never share a token. Empty by default: while projectKey is empty, render.py builds the page with no counter at all (no script; that is the mode tests/fixtures/t1-page-no-counter.golden.html pins for page.build_page on the tests' own data, and the mode releases/t1/page.html is in). Once it is set, render.py checks it with page.counter_config before anything is fetched or rendered and passes {"host": apiHost, "key": projectKey} to page.build_page: a personal API key (phx_), anything that is not a project token (phc_) or any host but the two PostHog cloud ingestion hosts stops the render. projectKey is the project's public token: public by design, it appears in the page source. apiHost is the ingestion host of the organisation's cloud, https://eu.i.posthog.com or https://us.i.posthog.com. projectId is the numeric id of the same project; it is not a secret and the page never uses it - the T1 reach read, when built, reads it here, never from site.json. All three are written by the colony the minute after the owner's organisation click (step 6 part ד; M4 of the ruling's §2), never by the owner, and only after the project has session recording off, the GeoIP transformation off, 'Discard client IP data' on and cookieless server-hash mode on, each read back. The token is set once, before D0, and never regenerated while a clock runs: a regenerated token revokes the old one at once and would turn a live page's counter off mid-clock.
